landing_seo_title: Cohub — a living space where people and agents build together
landing_seo_description: A living space where people and agents create, play, and build together. Open a Space, work with an Agent on real files, save checkpoints, and publish live apps.
landing_og_description: Open a Space, build with an Agent on real files, save checkpoints, and publish live apps.
landing_hero_title_1: A living space where people and agents
landing_hero_lede: Open a Space and you get a real computer, an agent to work with, and room for friends to join in. Publish anything that comes out of it.
landing_hero_media_alt: A Cohub Space chat with the repo README open in preview, LLM usage stats, and the file tree
landing_section_sameroom_title: Everyone in the Space shares the same context.
landing_section_sameroom_lede: Chats are not private threads. Keep going in someone else's, or fork from any message to take your own line. Messages drift past so you know what everyone is up to.
landing_section_liveapps_title: Publish something people can play with.
landing_section_liveapps_lede: A game, a demo, a weird little tool: publish it from a file, a directory, or a running port. Visitors get something live, not a screenshot. And if you let it, an app can even reach back and change the Space behind it.
landing_section_everywhere_lede: Start on the web, keep going on your phone, reach agents from Discord or WeChat, and drive the same Space from your terminal.
landing_section_everywhere_media_alt: Cohub running on a phone, with the same Space and chat
landing_section_everywhere_media_label: Mobile — a Space on a phone
landing_section_anymedium_title: Text, images, video, music, and running code.
landing_section_anymedium_lede: Generation happens in the conversation, not in a separate tool — results land in the Space as files.
landing_section_context_lede: Mention @space and another Space joins the conversation as context. Type / and reusable skills are already there. Fork a Save and start with its files loaded — context compounds instead of resetting.
landing_section_context_media_alt: Mentioning another Space from the composer, with the mention picker open
landing_section_sandbox_title: Every Space gets a real computer.
landing_section_sandbox_lede: Everything above runs on an isolated environment behind each Space, ready to build, serve, schedule, and keep working while you are away.
landing_closing_title: Start a Space. See where it goes.
landing_closing_lede: Free to try, open source, and yours to self-host.
landing_footer_tagline: A living space where people and agents create, play, and build together.
proof_built_open_sub: Cohub is developed inside a public Cohub Space
sb_ports_desc: A process listening on a public port becomes a preview you can watch, and an App you can publish.
sb_scheduled_desc: Send a prompt once at a set time, or on a recurring schedule, so an agent picks up routine work without being asked.
sb_hooks_desc: Run scripts on Space events — a finished turn, a file change — with filters that decide exactly when they fire.
sb_pi_desc: The agent runtime is built on the open-source pi harness.
pricing_seo_description: Simple, transparent pricing for Cohub agent work. Pay for the agent work you run.
pricing_headline: Pay for the agent work you run.
pricing_checkout_unavailable: Checkout is not available right now.
pricing_lede: Plans are a monthly usage balance in USD. Spend it on any model, any Space, from any surface — and get more balance than you pay for.

pricing_free_lede: The Free plan includes a starter balance. No card required.
pricing_faq_balance_a: Balance is usage credit in USD. Model calls, sandbox runs and generations are metered against it per use; you can see every charge in Settings → Billing.
pricing_faq_first_q: How does the first-order discount work?
pricing_faq_first_a: It applies automatically to your first subscription and to the first purchase of each balance pack. You see the discounted total before paying; renewals bill at the regular price.
pricing_faq_cancel_a: Yes, any time from Settings → Billing. You keep the plan until the end of the period you already paid for.
pricing_faq_packs_a: Plans refill every month and give more balance per dollar. Packs are one-off top-ups, valid for 24 months, and stack on top of any plan.
pricing_faq_selfhost_a: Yes. Cohub is Apache-2.0 and runs on your own infrastructure — you bring your own model keys.
